translations.text: I confess to God almighty, to all God's angels, to all God's saints and to you, God's messenger, all my sins, and I will make confession of them as I committed them: whatever wrong I saw or whatever wrong I consented to;
wrong words, wrong deeds, wrong thoughts; evil desires, evil will; cursing, lying, slander;
wrong standing, wrong sitting; untimely sleeping, untimely waking, untimely food, untimely drink; consuming food without measure;
my vomiting, fornication, theft, manslaughter, false oaths, my broken fasts. I did not visit my church as I should have.
I neither honored nor kept Sundays and other holy days as I should have. I did not keep the holy law as I should have.
I did not complete my course of prayer as I should have. I was not obedient as I should have been. I did not receive the needy as I should have. I did not give alms as I should have.

Without permission I gave and took what I should not have. I did not reconcile two people at odds as I should have. I did not forgive sins to those I should have. I did not love my neighbors as I should have.
Of all this and of much else in which I am guilty before God, which I promised in my Christianity and which I abandoned through my human weakness,
and since my birth as a child, whether it happened to me sleeping or waking, whether I committed it myself or consented to another or enticed others to it, whether I remember it
or do not remember it, whether I thought it or saw it or did it or spoke it: of all of it I make confession to God almighty, to all God's saints and to you, man of God.
